pages.title: Hawking Radiation
pages.text: The faint glow of a black hole evaporating. Pairs of particles at the horizon are split, one falls in and the other escapes, carrying away a sliver of the black hole's mass. It is thermal, dim and cold, and in it the hole slowly dies.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hawking showed black holes are not quite black. Feeding a Kugelblitz Seed through the Penrose Ergosphere Generator, my detectors picked up a thermal glow leaking from the horizon itself.
